finalists.label: Lynch Syndrome
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive evidence, including a germline mutation in the MSH6 gene and a significant family history of prostate cancer.

finalists.label: Endometrial hyperplasia
finalists.why: It is supported by the presentation of abnormal vaginal bleeding and the performance of dilation and curettage.

finalists.label: Hereditary Cancer Syndrome
finalists.why: It is supported by the family history of prostate cancer and the detection of a germline mutation in the MSH6 gene.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings, including the specific germline mutation in the MSH6 gene and the family history of prostate cancer, which are not fully explained by the runner-up.
